description: This file defines the ExtensionSet class in the Twig templating engine, managing extensions, filters, functions, tests, token parsers, node visitors, and operators within Twig.

classes.name: ExtensionSet
classes.description: Manages Twig extensions, including registration, retrieval, and initialization of filters, functions, tests, token parsers, node visitors, and operators.

methods.name: initRuntime
methods.description: Initializes the runtime environment for Twig extensions.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is registered.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a registered extension by class name.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded signature of registered extensions.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if extensions have been initialized.

methods.name: getLastModified
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of extensions.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific function by name.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFunctionCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for undefined functions.

methods.name: registerUndefinedFilterCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for undefined filters.

methods.name: getTokenParser
methods.description: Retrieves a token parser by name.

methods.name: registerUndefinedTokenParserCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for undefined token parsers.

methods.name: initExtensions
methods.description: Initializes all extensions, filters, functions, tests, parsers, visitors, and operators.

methods.name: initExtension
methods.description: Initializes a single extension, registering its filters, functions, tests, parsers, visitors, and operators.
